column1: ## M6  the anatomy of round 37's diverged dumps
## There is none. All five arms ended on budget with divergedTotal 0 in the manifest and the
## report's cumulative `diverged` column at 0 on every one of the 300 samples, and no arm
## wrote a diverged/ directory at all. scripts/reads/diverged-read.py prints
## "no diverged/ dumps" for each. So every question the brief asks of the dumps -- how many
## parts, the root's height, its radius from the axis, the age, jointed or not, whether the
## height guard or the radius guard named the death, and the share of bodies within a metre
## of the glass -- has no data in round 37, because nothing diverged.
## V4 of logbook/0093 ("no diverged dump whose reason is the radius guard") therefore holds
## vacuously: no body went through the glass, and none was thrown.
